body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled 'IceTouch', its new mp3 player equipped with a 2-inch transparent AMOLED screen during Samsung press conference at CES 2010.

The IceTouch adopts the company's new UI called 'TouchWiz Sweep' which allows users to browse the menu with a tapping and swiping motion of the finger. With the company's exclusive sound technology better than DNSe, it also brings enhanced video playback, supporting a variety of video file formats such as DivX, MPEG4, XviD, H.264 and more.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
